detailedErrors.originalErrorDesc: Data Integrity Violation – The Payload must not contain more than one record with the same Service Identifier Number,Service Type,Owner Order No, Record Status for a given record. Each Service Identifier Number,Service Type,Owner Order No, Record Status must be unique within its associated record.
